page.overview:
Who is Hai Jun?

Hai Jun was from Penquan Island, an eastern island in the Fire Nation that was stuck under an oppressive rule under the de facto leader, Sheriff Panzo. For decades, he smuggled people off the island using his fishing boat, hating how Panzo forced boys to fight for him and prevented girls from practicing firebending. One of the people he had helped escape was Naoki, a woman who was seen as a troublemaker by the sheriff. For many years, Panzo attempted to identify the person who secretly helped locals escape from the island, but Hai Jun managed to evade his grasp.

After Naoki got settled in Republic City, she began to assist Hai Jun. When he brought people to Republic City, she would helped them find jobs and housing.

In the mid-170's AG, he helped Hisa and her adopted children escape the island. He planned to stay at the Ember Sea Suite in Republic City for a while, though Hisa urged him to stay for good. At this point, however, Panzo finally discovered that Hai Jun was heading the smuggling operations, and sent his forces to kidnap him from the Ember Sea Suite. Afterward, the fisherman was brought back to Penquan Island and thrown into an underground cell back at cave prison. Not long after, Hisa was also imprisoned at the location.

Days later, he was freed by Bolin, who had come to the island alongside Mako to investigate his disappearance from Republic City as well as their mother's past. After being let out from his cell, he embraced with Hisa and told her that she did not need to apologize, saying he always knew the risks involved with sneaking people off the island. Afterward, Hai Jun informed Bolin and Mako about the nature of Panzo's tyrannical regime on the island.
